traffic_forecast_summary: Observed during hosted trial: sustained QPS ~4 (avg), 95th percentile spikes to 18 QPS during peak load tests. Token mix by request volume: chat 60% (avg 420 tokens per request), embeddings 25% (avg 1k tokens when batching for vectors), reranking 15% (higher token counts per call). Forecast for next 6 months (conservative): steady-state QPS 6-8, typical concurrency 10-12, expected peak concurrency 28-32 during feature launches. Monthly token throughput estimate ~120M tokens (prompt+completion) at scale scenario. They want capacity to handle 95th percentile with <300ms p95 for chat and batched embedding throughput >=200 qps when idle CPU/GPU batching enabled.
dedicated_capacity_needs: Customer goal: Dedicated pool for predictable latency and cost. SE recommends initial Dedicated of 2 x A100-80GB equivalents (or 4 x A10G depending on cost) with autoscale to +50% burst. Config: routing policy to send embeddings to separate pool with larger batch sizes; chat pool optimized for low-latency kernels and KV cache. Target SLAs: p95 <300ms for chat, tail <600ms for heavy reranks. Include prefix caching for common flows to reduce token spend. Recommend enabling continuous batching for embeddings and quantization profiles for model variants to lower cost.
poc_results_key_metrics: Hosted trial key metrics: avg latency (chat) = 180ms, p95 = 310ms (with transient spikes during token-heavy reranks), embeddings batch throughput 45 qps when unbatched, improved to 160 qps when batched by 64. Observed token mix: prompt avg 120 tokens, completion avg 300 tokens (chat). Cost observed (hosted): ~$0.15 per 1k tokens effective on trial volumes; finance wants projections for 1M/10M/100M token bands. Stability: no production incidents; one support ticket RDW-4123 around transient 429s at high concurrency (reproducible with synthetic load).
pricing_notes: AE provided hosted pricing during trial. Customer prefers a committed Dedicated package with monthly reservation. Initial ask: quote for committed usage equivalent to 2x A100/month with 10% discount for 12-month commit; also a burst credit pool for unexpected launches. Finance requested line-item for network egress and support SLAs. Ask from customer: add 'performance credits' if p95 exceeds target twice in a billing month.
